UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH ASSOCIATE
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Research Associate in the DBT
Research Project entitled “Biovalorization of Lignin – To develop and evaluate the performance of
lignin-derived nanomaterials” under the supervision of Dr. Sandip V. Pawar, Assistant Professor,
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
1. PhD or M. Pharm/M.Tech (having 3 years of research/industrial experience with at least one
research paper in SCI journal) preferably in Pharmacology/Pharmaceutics/Pharmaceutical
Biotechnology) with minimum 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PH)
2. GATE/GPAT (M. Pharm/M. Tech candidates) qualified or any National entrance test exam
conducted by any central Govt. department is desirable.
3. Preference will be given to the candidates with industrial/research experience or candidates having
work experience in cancer research, drug development, in-vitro mammalian cell culture, in-vivo
animal models, molecular Biology techniques (western blot/ELISA/RT-PCR) will be preferred.
Fellowship:
The Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be (58000/pm + 18%HRA), as admissible under the
applicable rules. The fellowship shall be tenable for a period of eight months only and shall remain
strictly limited to the prescribed tenure.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview in the office of Chairperson, UIPS,
Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Application form along with curriculum Vitae and documents supporting essential qualification may be
submitted to the office of the undersigned by email (pawars@pu.ac.in) latest by 6th October 2026. The
date and time of the interview will be informed to the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate
interview letters will be issued and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The position
is purely on temporary basis and is coterminous with the project.
Dr. Sandip V. Pawar
UIPS, Panjab University,
Chandigarh-160014
pawars@pu.ac.in
